headline: LeviLauncher v1.5.28
summary: You can now launch Minecraft regardless of where it was installed, with the Google Play Store check removed.

items.text: Removed the Google Play Store validation, so you can play with only Minecraft installed. Any install of com.mojang.minecraftpe is accepted instead of Play Store builds only.
Added a GitHub Actions workflow that builds and signs the launcher APKs and publishes them with each release.
